title: 我的家
content: 我叫小王。我家有四个人：爸爸、妈妈、姐姐和我。我们住在中国。我爸爸是老师，我妈妈是医生。姐姐是大学生。我们家有一只小狗，它叫七七。我很爱我的家。
content_pinyin: wǒ jiào xiǎo Wáng 。 wǒ jiā yǒu sì gè rén ： bà ba 、 mā ma 、 jiě jie hé wǒ 。 wǒ men zhù zài Zhōng guó 。 wǒ bà ba shì lǎo shī ， wǒ mā ma shì yī shēng 。 jiě jie shì dà xué shēng 。 wǒ men jiā yǒu yī zhī xiǎo gǒu ， tā jiào qī qī 。 wǒ hěn ài wǒ de jiā 。
translation: My name is Xiao Wang. There are four people in my family: dad, mom, my older sister and me. We live in China. My dad is a teacher, my mom is a doctor. My sister is a university student. We have a little dog; it is called Qiqi. I love my family very much.

title: 今天的天气
content: 今天天气很好，不冷。我和朋友想去外边玩。我们九点半在学校见。我和朋友去商店买东西，也喝了茶。下午我回家，很高兴。
content_pinyin: jīn tiān tiān qì hěn hǎo ， bù lěng 。 wǒ hé péng you xiǎng qù wài bian wán 。 wǒ men jiǔ diǎn bàn zài xué xiào jiàn 。 wǒ hé péng you qù shāng diàn mǎi dōng xi ， yě hē le chá 。 xià wǔ wǒ huí jiā ， hěn gāo xìng 。
translation: The weather is nice today, not cold. My friend and I want to go outside to play. We meet at school at half past nine. We go to the shop together to buy things, and also drink tea. In the afternoon I go home, very happy.

title: 我的一天
content: 我早上七点起床，吃早饭。早饭有鸡蛋和牛奶。八点我去学校上课。中午我吃午饭。下午五点我回家，学习，看电视。晚上我睡觉。
content_pinyin: wǒ zǎo shang qī diǎn qǐ chuáng ， chī zǎo fàn 。 zǎo fàn yǒu jī dàn hé niú nǎi 。 bā diǎn wǒ qù xué xiào shàng kè 。 zhōng wǔ wǒ chī wǔ fàn 。 xià wǔ wǔ diǎn wǒ huí jiā ， xué xí ， kàn diàn shì 。 wǎn shang wǒ shuì jiào 。
translation: I get up at seven in the morning and eat breakfast. Breakfast is eggs and milk. At eight I go to school for class. At noon I eat lunch. At five in the afternoon I go home, study, and watch TV. At night I sleep.

title: 买东西
content: 今天我和妈妈去商店买东西。商店里有很多水果，很漂亮。苹果不贵，一些苹果是十二块钱。我也想买一件衣服，太贵了。我们买了水果，回家。
content_pinyin: jīn tiān wǒ hé mā ma qù shāng diàn mǎi dōng xi 。 shāng diàn lǐ yǒu hěn duō shuǐ guǒ ， hěn piào liang 。 píng guǒ bù guì ， yì xiē píng guǒ shì shí èr kuài qián 。 wǒ yě xiǎng mǎi yī jiàn yī fu ， tài guì le 。 wǒ men mǎi le shuǐ guǒ ， huí jiā 。
translation: Today mom and I go to the shop to buy things. There is a lot of fruit in the shop, very pretty. The apples are not expensive; some apples are twelve yuan. I also want to buy a piece of clothing, but it is too expensive. We buy fruit and go home.

title: 在饭店
content: 晚上，我和家人去饭店吃饭。我们点了米饭、饺子和一些菜。弟弟喜欢吃包子。菜很好吃，我们都很高兴。吃饭后，爸爸请问多少钱。
content_pinyin: wǎn shang ， wǒ hé jiā rén qù fàn diàn chī fàn 。 wǒ men diǎn le mǐ fàn 、 jiǎo zi hé yì xiē cài 。 dì di xǐ huan chī bāo zi 。 cài hěn hǎo chī ， wǒ men dōu hěn gāo xìng 。 chī fàn hòu ， bà ba qǐng wèn duō shao qián 。
translation: In the evening, my family and I go to a restaurant to eat. We order rice, dumplings and some dishes. My younger brother likes to eat baozi. The food is delicious; we are all happy. After the meal, dad asks how much it costs.

title: 我的朋友
content: 我有一个好朋友，她叫小李。她是我的同学。她很漂亮，也很忙。她喜欢读书，也喜欢唱歌。星期天我们去看电影。我们是好朋友。
content_pinyin: wǒ yǒu yī gè hǎo péng you ， tā jiào xiǎo Lǐ 。 tā shì wǒ de tóng xué 。 tā hěn piào liang ， yě hěn máng 。 tā xǐ huan dú shū ， yě xǐ huan chàng gē 。 xīng qī tiān wǒ men qù kàn diàn yǐng 。 wǒ men shì hǎo péng you 。
translation: I have a good friend; she is called Xiao Li. She is my classmate. She is very pretty and also very busy. She likes reading, and also likes singing. On Sunday we go to watch a movie together. We are good friends.
